Rashi on Shabbat 111b:1:1.hebrew: אסור להדוקיה - בנקב משום סחיטה, ואע"ג דלא קא מכוין לסחוט; אלמא לא ס"ל כר"ש בדבר שאין מתכוין:
Rashi on Shabbat 111b:1:1.english: It is prohibited to insert it tightly - into the hole, because of [the prohibition of] wringing, even though he does not intend to wring; thus, he does not hold like Rabbi Shimon regarding an unintentional act.

Rashi on Shabbat 111b:2:1.hebrew: הלכה כר' יהודה - בדבר שאין מתכוין דאסור:
Rashi on Shabbat 111b:2:1.english: The halakha is in accordance with Rabbi Yehuda - Regarding an unintentional act, that it is forbidden.

Rashi on Shabbat 111b:2:2.hebrew: בלי גברי - מתני לה לפלוגתא דרב ושמואל בלא אמוראים האומרים משמם, אלא הם עצמם נחלקו בה:
Rashi on Shabbat 111b:2:2.english: Without men - [He] teaches the dispute of Rav and Shmuel without Amoraim who say [it] in their names; rather, they themselves disputed it.

Rashi on Shabbat 111b:2:3.english: We explained [it] - So that [one statement of] Rav does not contradict [another statement of] Rav.

Rashi on Shabbat 111b:2:4.hebrew: הלכה כר"ש - דשרי בשמן וורד:
Rashi on Shabbat 111b:2:4.english: The halakha is in accordance with Rabbi Shimon - Who permits rose oil.

Rashi on Shabbat 111b:3:1.english: But not for his reason - For the reason is not according to his words.

Rashi on Shabbat 111b:3:2.hebrew: דאילו ר"ש סבר מסי - ואפ"ה שרי, דאין לך דמותר לזה ואסור לזה:
Rashi on Shabbat 111b:3:2.english: Whereas Rabbi Shimon holds [that it] heals - And even so, [it is] permitted, for you do not have [anything] that is permitted to this [person] and forbidden to that [person].

Rashi on Shabbat 111b:3:3.hebrew: מכלל דמסי - אפי' לת"ק, דאי לאו דמסי, למאי איצטריך ליה:
Rashi on Shabbat 111b:3:3.english: By inference, [it] heals - Even according to the first Tanna, for if [it were] not that it heals, why would he need [to teach] it?

Rashi on Shabbat 111b:3:4.hebrew: אע"ג דלא שכיח - שמן וורד במקומו של זה הסך ממנו, ודמיו יקרים, והכל יודעין שאינו סכו אלא לרפואה — שרי, דכל ישראל בני מלכים הם. ור' יהודה אוסר, דמוכחא מילתא. ורב נמי כר"י ס"ל, אלא במקומו הוא דשרי, דשכיח דסכין שמן וורד ולא מוכחא מילתא:
Rashi on Shabbat 111b:3:4.english: Even though it is uncommon - [That is, even though] rose oil [is uncommon] in the place of the one who anoints [himself] with it, and its price is high, and everyone knows that he is anointing with it only for healing — it is permitted, for all of Israel are princes. And Rabbi Yehuda forbids [it], because the matter is obvious. And Rav also holds like Rabbi Yehuda, except that in his [own] place it is permitted, because it is common [there] to anoint [with] rose oil, and the matter is not obvious.

Rashi on Shabbat 111b:5:1.hebrew: ואלו קשרים - המנוין באבות מלאכות, דקתני הקושר והמתיר — קשר של קיימא שאינו מתירו לעולם, דומיא דקושרי חוטי יריעות הנפסקות:
Rashi on Shabbat 111b:5:1.english: And these are knots - Which are enumerated among the primary categories of labor, as [the Mishnah] teaches: "One who ties and one who unties" — [meaning] a permanent knot that one never unties, similar to those who tie the threads of [Tabernacle] curtains that tear.

Rashi on Shabbat 111b:5:2.english: A camel driver's knot and a sailor's knot - The Gemara explains them.

Rashi on Shabbat 111b:5:3.hebrew: כך הוא חייב על היתרן - כדילפי' בכלל גדול (לעיל שבת דף עד:) מציידי החלזון, שנצרכין לפרקים להתיר קשרי רשתות הקיימות כדי לקצרן או להרחיבן:
Rashi on Shabbat 111b:5:3.english: So too, he is liable for untying them - As we derive in [the chapter] Kelal Gadol (above, Shabbat 74b) from the trappers of the chilazon, who need at times to untie the knots of permanent nets in order to shorten them or widen them.

Rashi on Shabbat 111b:5:4.english: That one can untie it - Since he did not tighten it.

Rashi on Shabbat 111b:5:5.hebrew: אין חייבין עליו - ואפי' עשאו לקיימא:
Rashi on Shabbat 111b:5:5.english: One is not liable for it - Even if he made it [to remain] permanently.

Rashi on Shabbat 111b:6:1.hebrew: זממא - מנקבין לנאקה בחוטמ', ונותנין בה טבעת של רצועה וקושרין אותה, ועומדת שם לעולם. וכשרוצה לקושרה לבהמה, קושר רצועה ארוכה באותה טבעת וקושרין בה, ופעמים שמתירה:
Rashi on Shabbat 111b:6:1.english: Zemama - They pierce a she-camel in its nose, place a ring [made] of a strap in it and tie it, and it remains there permanently. And when one wants to tie the animal, he ties a long strap to that ring and ties [the animal] with it, and sometimes unties it.

Rashi on Shabbat 111b:6:2.english: A knot that they tie to the nose ring - This is the knot of the straps that they tie to the ring.

Rashi on Shabbat 111b:6:3.hebrew: איסטרידא - גם הוא כמין טבעת שעושין מן עקל או מן רצועה בנקב שבראש הספינה, ואותו קשר מתקיים. וכשרוצה להעמידו, קושר רצועה באותה טבעת ומעמידה בה, וכשרוצה להתיר, מתיר הרצועה ונוטלה:
Rashi on Shabbat 111b:6:3.english: Isterida - It is also a kind of ring that they make from a rope or from a strap in a hole at the bow of the ship, and that knot remains permanent. And when he wishes to moor it, he ties a strap to that ring and moors [the ship] with it; and when he wishes to untie [it], he unties the strap and takes it [away].

Rashi on Shabbat 111b:6:4.english: A knot that they tie to the isterida [ring] - The knot of the long strap.

Rashi on Shabbat 111b:7:1.hebrew: עניבה - ומהדקה שפיר, לר"מ מהו:
Rashi on Shabbat 111b:7:1.english: A bow - And [where] one tightens it well, what is [the ruling] according to Rabbi Meir?

Rashi on Shabbat 111b:8:1.hebrew: יש לך קשרין שאין חייבין עליהן - חטאת, כמו שחייבין על קשר הגמלין, אלא פטור אבל אסור. ובגמרא מפרש הי נינהו:
Rashi on Shabbat 111b:8:1.english: You have knots for which one is not liable - [to bring] a sin-offering, as one is liable for a camel-driver's knot; rather, [it is] exempt yet prohibited. And in the Gemara, it explains which ones they are.

Rashi on Shabbat 111b:8:2.hebrew: מפתח חלוקה - כמו שיש לגלחים כעין לשונות לכאן ולכאן, וקושרים של ימין בכתף שמאל ושל שמאל בכתף ימין. דכיון דכל יומא שרו ליה, לא דמי מידי לקשר של קיימא, ומותר לכתחילה:
Rashi on Shabbat 111b:8:2.english: Opening of her robe - Like that which priests have, resembling tongues [straps] on either side, and they tie [the one] of the right [side] on the left shoulder and [the one] of the left [side] on the right shoulder. For since they untie it every day, it does not resemble a permanent knot at all, and it is permitted from the outset.

Rashi on Shabbat 111b:8:3.english: Hairnet - [In Old French:] coife [a coif, or close-fitting cap].

Rashi on Shabbat 111b:8:4.hebrew: ושל פסקיא - אזור רחב, וחוטין תלויין בראשו לקושרו בהן, וקורין פינדור"ס:
Rashi on Shabbat 111b:8:4.english: And [the strings] of a girdle - [This is] a wide belt, with cords hanging at its end to tie it with, and they call [them] pendoirs [Old French for "hanging cords"].

Rashi on Shabbat 111b:8:5.hebrew: ונודות יין - של עור, שכופפין פיהם וקושרין:
Rashi on Shabbat 111b:8:5.english: And wineskins - [They are made] of leather, whose mouths one folds over and ties.

Rashi on Shabbat 111b:8:6.english: And a pot of meat - Sometimes they tie a cloth over its mouth.

Rashi on Shabbat 111b:8:7.english: One may tie before an animal - [One ties] a rope across the width of the entrance.

Tosafot on Shabbat 111b:1:1.hebrew: מודה ר"ש בפסיק רישיה - והא דאמר גבי "לא ליהדוק אינש אודרא אפומא דשישא, דילמא אתי לידי סחיטה" ולא הוי פסיק רישיה — יש לחלק: דהתם מיירי בכיסוי שאינו בולע כ"כ, וגם אינו סותמו כל כך בחוזק, שאינו חושש רק שיהא מכוסה; אבל הכא, שהוא בצד הגיגית, בולע הרבה, וגם מהדקו בחוזק כדי שלא יצא היין, והוי פסיק רישיה:
Tosafot on Shabbat 111b:1:1.english: "Rabbi Shimon concedes in [a case of] pesik reishei [an inevitable consequence]" - And [as for] that which [the Gemara] says regarding "a person should not tightly stuff a cloth into the mouth of a flask lest he come to wringing," [where] it is not [considered] pesik reishei — one can distinguish: there it is speaking of a cover that does not absorb so much, and also he does not stop it up so tightly, as he is only concerned that it be covered; whereas here, since it is at the side of the vat, it absorbs a great deal, and he also presses it in tightly so that the wine will not leak out, and [therefore] it is pesik reishei.

Tosafot on Shabbat 111b:1:2.hebrew: ושלש מחלוקות בדבר - אית ספרים דל"ג ליה:
Tosafot on Shabbat 111b:1:2.english: "And [there are] three disputes in the matter" - There are texts that do not have this reading.

Tosafot on Shabbat 111b:5:1.hebrew: ואלו קשרים. עניבה לר"מ מהו - וא"ת: אמאי לא פשיטא מדתנן לקמן: "חבל דלי שנפסק לא יהא קושרו אלא עונבו", ומוכח' בפ"ק דפסחים (ד' יא.) דהנהו רבנן היינו ר"מ, דפריך התם מינה לרבנן שהם ר"מ? וי"ל דהתם נמי פריך מספק, אם הנהו רבנן הם ר"מ, כמו שמסתפק כאן:
Tosafot on Shabbat 111b:5:1.english: And these are knots. What is [the law regarding] a bow according to Rabbi Meir - And if you ask: why is it not obvious from what we learned in the Mishnah later on: "If a bucket rope snapped, one may not tie it [with a knot], rather one ties it in a bow," and it is proven in the first chapter of Pesachim (11a) that those Rabbis [in that Mishnah] are Rabbi Meir, for there [the Gemara] raises an objection from it against the Rabbis — who are Rabbi Meir? One can answer that there too [the Gemara] raises the objection out of doubt as to whether those Rabbis are Rabbi Meir, just as it is in doubt here.
